dimensions.observation: Formal camera reads as a courtyard with a hero tree, planters, bench, edge planting and background layers; playable path is clear.
dimensions.gap: The plaza still leaves more empty paving than P1, and foreground framing is weaker than the reference.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3 for the sample; if a later pass adds foreground planting/props, rescore. Not a key blocking defect.

dimensions.observation: Tree crown uses a solid mass plus smaller clumps; planters have real blocks, joints and soil; bench/lamp/fence are native meshes.
dimensions.gap: Crown still shows some faceted mass planes; paving and planter profiles are simpler than P1.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3; geometry is coherent and no broken/floating object is visible in formal or close-up views.

dimensions.observation: Stone reads warm grey with tile variation, bench wood carries grain along slats, lamp/fence metal has controlled specular, soil is darker and rough.
dimensions.gap: No key defect in the tested formal and close-up views; wear and micro-detail are still simpler than P1.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 for multiple engine views; material families are distinct and consistent.

dimensions.observation: Warm key and cool fill, soft contact shadows and a grounded player shadow; fixed ROI measurement shows deeper shadows and higher contrast than the prior build.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; absolute brightness on the paving is nearly unchanged (delta 0) while shadows deepen, so this is contrast, not a global brightness claim.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4; fixed camera and ROI evidence match the actual images.

dimensions.observation: Near hedge with leaf cards, mid planters with layered shrubs/grass/litter, and a distant olive crown band provide three depth layers without bare trunks.
dimensions.gap: The background band is still stylized and geometric; no key defect in the formal view.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4; vegetation depth is visible consistently in formal and close-up views.

dimensions.observation: Player, NPC, tree, path, quest card and interaction button are readable at the formal camera; character height measured 97.8 px (target 86-130).
dimensions.gap: No key defect; the player remains readable in front of the tree.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with two camera/interaction views.

dimensions.observation: The locked reference Spine silhouette is preserved: twin-tail mass, coat tails and weapon read at small scale.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; the source identity is not redrawn.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with idle/move and dialogue views.

dimensions.observation: Linework comes from the original Spine atlas and remains clean at 1x and in dialogue portrait use.
dimensions.gap: No key defect in the captured states.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4; idle/move and asset preview evidence.

dimensions.observation: Cel colors match the reference character; the 2D sprite is not re-lit by the 3D scene, so its shading is source-consistent rather than integrated.
dimensions.gap: The character keeps its own cel shading; no scene light response is claimed.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3; identity and line are strong, but cel integration is intentionally source-based.

dimensions.observation: Hair, red/black outfit, weapon and twin-tail silhouette match the locked 1015_aglna2 source across idle, move and dialogue.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; source is read from the effective contract, not redrawn.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with three states.

dimensions.observation: Idle and move loops are real Spine playback; the contact shadow is a runtime node at the player position (measured drift 0.000 m).
dimensions.gap: Move is a short loop; no long traversal or turn animation was captured.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3 for the sample; no foot/shadow drift.

dimensions.observation: At the formal camera the player is 97.8 px tall and remains readable against the paving and foliage.
dimensions.gap: Small details merge at this scale, as expected for a 2D sprite; no key defect.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3; character height is within the required 86-130 px.

dimensions.observation: Cream paper panels with a thin double border, soft translucency and portrait framing are consistent across HUD/dialogue/title.
dimensions.gap: The paper is still more opaque and more uniformly bordered than P1's thin translucent sheets.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3; readable and coherent, with a known style gap.

dimensions.observation: A single 21-icon family (talk, pickup, place, view, retry, sound, menu, lock, leaf, etc.) plus sparkle/leaf doodles is used consistently.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; icon stroke weight is consistent across states.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with the icon sheet and multiple UI states.

dimensions.observation: Chinese title/body/label hierarchy uses the bundled Noto fonts: title 64, speaker 28, body 24, page 13; native-size engine text is legible.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; the body still uses a single weight.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with title, HUD and dialogue states.

dimensions.observation: HUD sits in the corners with clear breathing room; dialogue spans the lower band without covering the player at default position.
dimensions.gap: Panels are larger and more rectangular than P1's airy asymmetric layout.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3; interaction targets are clear and not overlapping.

dimensions.observation: 41 real states are captured: title/loading/failure, all HUD counts, interact/disabled/hidden, joystick, dialogue pages, pause, complete, toast, tips, safe-area and rotate notice.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; every state has a distinct visual response.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with the current-build state index and representative state images.

dimensions.observation: Cream paper, ink text, restrained gold and mint accents; no saturated global filter.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; accents are limited to status/page/icon details.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with multiple UI states.

dimensions.observation: Low-poly autumn world, detailed anime Spine character and paper UI share a warm cream/ochre palette and rounded prop language.
dimensions.gap: The 2D character and 3D world use different rendering languages; P1 is more uniformly painterly.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3 for the sample; this is a known style gap, not a broken composite.

dimensions.observation: Warm key, cool fill, deep contact shadows and cream/mint UI are coherent across formal, dialogue and close-up views; fixed ROI measurement matches the images.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; P1 has richer bounce light.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with measurement and multiple views.

dimensions.observation: Player shadow is attached at the player position (measured drift 0.000 m); behind-tree head region drops from 1321 to 110 near-white character pixels, confirming canopy occlusion.
dimensions.gap: No key defect; partial-edge occlusion at other props is not exhaustively tested.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with front/behind captures and the head-region metric.

dimensions.observation: Default composition focuses the hero tree, player and quest/dialogue UI; the player is not covered and the path stays readable.
dimensions.gap: No key defect in the captured states.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 4 with HUD/dialogue and landscape viewport evidence.

dimensions.observation: Props, tree, planters and UI all use the same stylized autumn language and palette.
dimensions.gap: Distant crown band and some planter silhouettes remain more geometric than P1.
dimensions.action_or_acceptance_reason: Accepted at 3; coherent, with a known background-detail gap.
